benchmark.name: SPG1_STRSG_Wu_2016 / GB1 four-site combinatorial landscape
benchmark.safety_scope: benign non-pathogenic protein benchmark; computational only
benchmark.source: ProteinGym-formatted public dataset mirrored in microsoft/InverseFoldDir

blind_protocol.candidate_generation: enumerate every syntactically valid 3- and 4-site amino-acid combination from the 20-aa alphabet and WT residues, without consulting hidden genotype IDs or hidden fitness
blind_protocol.hidden: all measured triple and quadruple mutants
blind_protocol.visible: WT plus all measured single and double mutants only

frozen_arms.ADDITIVE: WT fitness + sum of visible single-mutant effects
frozen_arms.LIGHTNING_B5: ADDITIVE + exact pair residuals gated/weighted by relative resonance and proof-backed exact mutation identity; Dream composes 3/4-mutant candidates; low-resonance candidates remain DORMANT rather than deleted
frozen_arms.PAIRWISE_RAW: ADDITIVE + sum of exact visible double-mutant epistasis residuals

interpretation_gate.do_not_claim: wet-lab validation, de novo physical synthesis, therapeutic utility, or universal protein-design capability
engineering_design_support_requires: LIGHTNING_B5 beats ADDITIVE on hidden top-tail metrics
LIGHTNING_B5 is competitive with or better than PAIRWISE_RAW on multiple top-tail metrics, not just global correlation
top candidate advantage is not carried by a single lucky variant

lightning_mapping.A4_core: protein identity + site + WT residue + ALT residue
lightning_mapping.CRM_identity: exact site+WT+ALT mutation token identity only
lightning_mapping.Dormant: candidate with zero mutual-resonance support remains retained but receives no resonance bonus
lightning_mapping.Dream: compose independently learned mutation tokens into unseen 3/4-site candidate genotypes
lightning_mapping.Memory: visible single effect and exact visible double epistasis residual
lightning_mapping.Relative_Resonance: for each mutation token, each partner interaction is normalized relative to that mutation's own visible pair-interaction distribution using exp((abs(e)-row_max)/row_std); mutual resonance is the geometric mean of the two directional attentions; no tuned scientific threshold
lightning_mapping.Verification: hidden experimental fitness is opened only after prediction freeze

primary_metrics: Spearman on measured hidden triple+quad variants
precision/enrichment for hidden top 1% and top 0.1%
best hidden fitness recovered in top 10/100/1000 generated candidates
fraction of top generated candidates that are experimentally measured
required_controls: bootstrap confidence intervals for top-k enrichment
